% A single decorated path: PGF computes one brace over its full polyline.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.pathreplacing}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[gray!35] (0,0) -- (3,0) -- (3,2);
  \draw[thick,decorate,
    decoration={brace,mirror,raise=4pt,amplitude=8pt,aspect=.32}]
    (0,0) -- (3,0) -- (3,2);
  \fill[red] (0,0) circle (1.1pt) (3,0) circle (1.1pt) (3,2) circle (1.1pt);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
